serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
RegDOX Cloud is delivered as a SaaS offering using a multi-tenant, 
AWS GovCloud hosted computing environment. It is available to 
federal contractors, government contractors and subcontractors, and 
U.S.-based companies for compliance with ITAR and federal 
procurement cyber-security regulations. 
RegDOX Cloud provides a secure collaboration platform designed 
specifically for regulatory compliance and document management 
within the authorization boundary of this Cloud Service Offering. 
(CSO). The service is tailored to meet the needs of regulated 
industries by facilitating secure document exchange and storage.
Services included within the authorization boundary of RegDOX
Cloud:
• Secure Document Management: RegDOX offers robust 
document storage and management capabilities, ensuring 
compliance with regulatory requirements such as FedRAMP 
Moderate.
• Collaboration Tools: Users can securely collaborate on 
documents within a controlled environment, with features for 
version control and audit trails.
• Access Control: Granular access controls and permissions 
management ensure only authorized personnel can view and 
modify sensitive documents.
• Encryption: Data is encrypted both in transit and at rest, 
providing a secure environment for sensitive information.
• Compliance Assurance: The platform supports compliance 
with regulatory standards and frameworks, including 
FedRAMP requirements.
Intended User Base: The RegDOX Cloud is designed for hybrid 
environments and Government-only community cloud environments. 
It serves government agencies, contractors, and organizations 
requiring robust document management and collaboration. security 
measures
